NonFatalError :: TrySyncResult entity
data Sync (m :: Type -> Type) entity
Sync :: (entity -> m (TrySyncResult entity)) -> Sync (m :: Type -> Type) entity
[trySync] :: Sync (m :: Type -> Type) entity -> entity -> m (TrySyncResult entity)
transformSync :: (forall a. () => m a -> n a) -> Sync m h -> Sync n h
data Progress (m :: Type -> Type) h
Progress :: (h -> m ()) -> (h -> m ()) -> (h -> m ()) -> m () -> Progress (m :: Type -> Type) h
[need] :: Progress (m :: Type -> Type) h -> h -> m ()
[done] :: Progress (m :: Type -> Type) h -> h -> m ()

transformProgress :: (forall a. () => m a -> n a) -> Progress m h -> Progress n h

-- | Calls <a>allDone</a> at the end
sync :: (Monad m, Show h) => Sync m h -> Progress m h -> [h] -> m ()

-- | Doesn't call <a>allDone</a> at the end, in case you plan to call sync
--   more than once.
